disclaimer: Curated internal clause-to-artifact map for tracking design-package completeness. This is NOT certification, conformance, or proof that requirements are met. `mapped` means only that every declared artifact resolves on disk. Standard text is interpreted at a high level; licensed normative text remains authoritative.

clauses.title: Identify stakeholders and their architecture-relevant concerns
clauses.requirement: An architecture description shall identify the system stakeholders and their concerns.

clauses.title: Frame concerns via architecture viewpoints
clauses.requirement: An architecture description shall include the architecture viewpoints used to frame the concerns.

clauses.title: Architecture views governed by viewpoints
clauses.requirement: An architecture description shall include one or more architecture views.

clauses.title: Record architecture decisions and their rationale
clauses.requirement: An architecture description shall record architecture decisions and the rationale for them.

clauses.title: Correspondence rules and consistency across the description
clauses.requirement: An architecture description shall define correspondences and be checked for consistency.

clauses.title: Functional completeness, correctness, appropriateness
clauses.requirement: Product quality model — degree to which functions meet stated and implied needs.

clauses.title: Time behaviour, resource utilization, capacity
clauses.requirement: Performance relative to the amount of resources used under stated conditions.

clauses.title: Co-existence and interoperability
clauses.requirement: Degree to which the product can exchange information and operate alongside other products.

clauses.title: Maturity, availability, fault tolerance, recoverability
clauses.requirement: Degree to which the system performs specified functions under specified conditions.

clauses.title: Confidentiality, integrity, accountability
clauses.requirement: Degree to which the product protects information and data.

clauses.title: Modularity, reusability, modifiability, testability
clauses.requirement: Degree of effectiveness with which the product can be modified.

clauses.title: Confirm specified requirements are fulfilled
clauses.requirement: Provide objective evidence that the system fulfils its specified requirements.

clauses.title: Manage configuration items, baselines, reproducibility
clauses.requirement: Establish and maintain integrity of work products via configuration control.

clauses.title: Govern and map AI risks across the lifecycle
clauses.requirement: Establish governance and map context/risks for the AI system.

clauses.title: Assess and document AI system impacts
clauses.requirement: Conduct and record an AI system impact assessment.

clauses.title: Post-deployment monitoring and AI incident response
clauses.requirement: Define incident response and ongoing monitoring for the deployed AI system.
